title: Training Notes: Joint Tri-Merge Reports When a Mortgage Loan File Credit Report Is Repulled
content:
**The rule.** For a credit report repull on a Mortgage Loan File, the report cost follows whether an earlier credit report fee charge on the same file covered two or more borrowers on a single pull, as shown by the number of borrowers pulled recorded on each credit report fee charge on the file's fee ledger:

- where one earlier credit report fee charge on the file covered two or more borrowers on a single pull and the file now has exactly two borrowers, the two are pulled again on one joint report whose cost is the per-borrower price times **1.40**;
- where such a joint pull exists and the file now has three or more borrowers, the first two are pulled on one joint report and every further borrower individually, so the report cost is the per-borrower price times **1.40** plus the per-borrower price for each borrower beyond two;
- where no earlier charge on the file covered two or more borrowers, or the file now has a single borrower, the report cost is the per-borrower price times the number of borrowers on the file.

## Questions answered

**What counts as an earlier joint pull?** Any one earlier credit report fee charge on the file whose recorded number of borrowers pulled is two or more. Two separate single-borrower charges are not a joint pull.

**A file had a joint pull of two borrowers and now has a third borrower. How is the cost made up?** One joint report for the first two at the per-borrower price times 1.40, plus one individual report at the per-borrower price for the third. With a hypothetical per-borrower price of 80.00 USD that is 112.00 USD plus 80.00 USD, which is 192.00 USD.

**Same file, still two borrowers?** One joint report: 80.00 USD times 1.40, which is 112.00 USD (hypothetical price).

**A file had a joint pull of two borrowers and now has a single borrower?** The single borrower is pulled individually: the per-borrower price times one, 80.00 USD at a hypothetical price.

**A file whose earlier charges each covered a single borrower now has two borrowers?** No joint pull exists, so each borrower is pulled individually: 80.00 USD times 2, which is 160.00 USD (hypothetical price).

| Earlier joint pull on the file | Borrowers now on the file | Report cost |
|---|---|---|
| yes | exactly 2 | per-borrower price times 1.40 |
| yes | 3 or more | per-borrower price times 1.40, plus the per-borrower price for each borrower beyond two |
| no | any number | per-borrower price times the number of borrowers |
| yes | 1 | per-borrower price times the number of borrowers (one) |
